records.title: COMPUTERISATION OF PACS
details:
(a) to (c): it was inter-alia state that As on 31 March 2026, 9,478 new Multi-Purpose Primary Agricultural Credit Societies 
(MPACS) were formed. For FY 2026-27, a target of 33,642 new MPACS has been set, based 
on the norm of one PACS per 5,000 population. The remaining 52,207 MPACS are envisaged 
for formation during FY 2027-28 and FY 2028-29. State/UT-wise targets for FY 2027-28 and 
FY 2028-29 have not been finalised.
